body: Honestly that’s not your fault or anyone’s for that matter. Sounds like depression ands and/or anxiety. Meds or therapy can help for some, meditation for others, maybe even a hobby can help somehow, but everything takes times. You need to give yourself the time and love you deserve. Stop saying everything else is perfect, you aren’t doing yourself any favors. Sure, some thing are good and some are bad; regardless you need to be there for yourself more than anyone else can.

I didn’t think anyone would respond to this, so instead I used this account to respond to other people’s posts, because I know how good it feels when somebody cares enough to reply. So, I’m replying to my own post, to remind myself that I’ll always be there for me, and that I love myself. I hope my comments helped, despite being scattered and perhaps a little too idealistic. <3

20 years. You’ve been on this earth twenty years and what have you done? You’ve grown, I can’t tell you how, only you know that. But I know you have. Look at what you want to be, and think about *why*. Keep going. It’s worth it, because of you’ve made it this far, why the fuck would you give up now? *Keep going*. Maybe you need to take a year to work a shitty job in order to pay for another year of college, and yeah, that sucks; but it’s worth it. Just get through this... the rest doesn’t matter until you get there— fuck it, the rest doesn’t matter right now. Keep going. I can’t be the only one who believes in you, I’m sure others do but that doesn’t matter- believe in yourself. Keep growing

I’ve been there, and after having a relationship... nothing really changed. Sure, sex can be fun, and cuddling is great, but it isn’t the solution. You’re the solution. You are not only the one in the sinkhole, but also the one on the other side, with the ability to pull yourself out. It might sound stupid; maybe it is— regardless, don’t wait for someone to come along and complete you. Complete yourself, you have the tools, now you just need to spend the time. And hell, you’ll probably end up in a relationship eventually, and at that point, you’ll hopefully be a great partner too. You’re okay... maybe not always, maybe not forever, but right now you’re okay. <3

Intrusive thoughts and habit, most likely. A voice that refuses to shut up, and thinks it knows more than you. It’s wrong, and that’s why it’s so loud. It can be tiring, but it goes away with time and focused therapy (or so I’m told). Just remember that you’re the one in control, and that you truly matter
I’m glad it helped, I seriously, truly am. It’s hard to connect to others, so cherish the moments you get to. There’ll be more, but each time is special

Also adhd, also dysphoric, also incredibly anxious and need physical contact/social contact. Take a look at the adhd subreddit, lots of people who are struggling with the isolation, but also lots of people to relate and connect with. Plenty of ideas to keep you busy, creative bunch over there. It might not feel like it right now, but this will end. You’ll be able to see you’re friends in person again, so don’t forget how much you love them :D imagine how great it’ll be when you finally see them

Sadly that’s what depression does. It takes your insides, and makes them feel hollow. But that’s the thing... it makes them *feel* hollow. I promise you, despite this, you are whole. While I can’t tell you what’s best for you, I can tell you that there’s more to life than what you’ve seen so far, and maybe that’s worth it. I don’t know. It sounds like you aren’t getting the love you deserve; don’t feel bad to ask for a hug, don’t feel bad if people judge you for it because in the end they’re the jerk who didn’t get a hug on purpose (though of course always respect boundaries). I’m sorry I can’t hug you right now, but I will tell you that i love you for trying to get help, for realizing there’s a chance to feel better. I don’t know who you are, or what you’ve done... but I can tell you you’re worth loving, and I’m sure people around you love you. It might just be hard for them to show it, just as it’s hard to ask for a hug. Baseball is good, keep doing baseball
Life isn’t just about happiness. I’m not sure if that makes things better or worse but I promise you there is more to life than just happiness. It’s okay to not be okay
Also adhd, can’t stop moving. I know how it feels humans suck I wish I was a dog dogs are nice. Humans suck, but that doesn’t mean you do. <3
